messages:
leah: Opening a cross-SDK docs PR to tidy up function/tool calling examples, add structured-output guardrails, and fix stale links. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5210 — can folks quick-review?

zahra: On it. I'll sweep the JS/TS snippets for the new API `redwood.callTool` vs old `invoke`.

tom: I'll check Go and Java examples. Found a few Go snippets still using `InvokeTool`; will replace with `client.CallTool(ctx, name, input)`.

arjun: Strong +1 for a short "Streaming & parseability" note. Suggest two patterns: 1) buffer full JSON before parse, 2) use lenient repair heuristics and capture diagnostics.

leah: Plan: add a tiny tolerant JSON Schema example (oneOf + nullable), a short diagnostics recipe (log last 512 chars, save raw_response), and code snippets for buffer + repair. Also replace dead playground links.

docs-bot: link-checker ran on branch -> 3 broken example links detected. Auto-commented on the PR.

zahra: JS snippet draft I'll add: `const buf = []; for await (const ch of client.streamTool(...)) buf.push(ch); const obj = JSON.parse(buf.join(''))` with a comment about large payloads.

arjun: Python repair example suggestion:
```python
raw = resp.text
try:
  obj = json.loads(raw)
except json.JSONDecodeError:
  log.warn('parse failed', raw[-512:])
  repaired = simple_repair(raw)
  obj = json.loads(repaired)
```

tom: Go example: `resp, err := client.CallTool(ctx, "search", input)` + note to strip envelopes before json.Unmarshal. I'll add a tiny test asserting enum validation fails for unexpected action string.

leah: Also add a one-paragraph guardrail: prefer explicit enums for action discriminators to avoid routing ambiguity. Short example schema: `{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"oneOf\":[{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"search\",\"open\",\"create\"]},{\"type\":\"null\"}]}}}`

zahra: I'll run JS lint/format after push. I'll also update the SDK idiom notes in the intro (callTool vs invoke).

arjun: Can we include a 1-line note about streaming token splits causing parse failures and recommend buffering or validating with a JSON streaming parser?

docs-bot: formatting checks queued.

leah: Targeting merge Friday. After merge, we'll open a follow-up issue to port these snippets into Private docs (VPC/on-prem) and the Go/Java module pages. Any blockers?

tom: No blockers. I'll push Go fixes today.

zahra: No blockers. Will push JS updates and run link-check locally.

arjun: I'll add the schema unit test and a tiny CI smoke check for the python repair helper.

leah: Thanks all — appreciate the fast turn. :thumbsup:
